entry_points.text: User signals: alt-stack copy and delegate, wide, narrow and compat disposition install and query, mask read, replace and three-mode block plus pending fetch, and one-shot install.
Callable entries: single-call interrupt drain, interrupt entry wrapper, on-CPU callback and hotplug thread loop.
Also enter via interrupt exit, softirq raise, tasklet and workqueue handlers, thread main and boot initializer.

exports.text: Disposition installer publishes handler for caller group with platform normalization; early layout check with cache creation; weak region hook.
Cross-call drain, async single with busy check, any and conditional broadcast, all-CPU kick, idle wake, pending peek, sync on-CPU with pinning and early setup.
Secondary bringup with idle and hotplug setup, count from possible mask, early SMP params with build-limit defaults, zero disabling secondaries, inline IPI key and ordered walks.
Softirq dispatch entries, post-flush pending check, nested bottom-half control, interrupt entry with timer and tick work, and paired daemon and handler wrappers.
Shared interrupt-exit accounting with optional context tracking, softirq raise and registration, tasklet enqueue and setup and init helpers.
Per-CPU queue and vector init with weak arch IRQ defaults, offline tasklet migration, threaded timer marks with drain thread, and bottom-half dead-CPU drain.

hazards.text: Alt-stack refused while on stack and when undersized with differing minima; identical no-ops; debugger uses nonblocking try with notice and refuses first delivery to non-running new target.
Preempt mismatch, bottom-half from hardirq, pending growth beyond scheduler bit and wrong-CPU run warn or fail with restore; idle alloc failure logs and leaves slot empty.

Kill from interrupt, unset clear, idle-exit, CPU mismatch and cursor misuse warn; work checks atomic, lock and read depths; spin uses cancel path on realtime and timer wake is suppressed in NMI and hardirq.

invariants.text: Install rejects reserved and immutable signals, strips non-ABI flags, excludes fatal and stop from masks, flushes queued when ignored and re-arms timers when un-ignored.
Drain needs disabled interrupts, reverses queue, warns once for offline, completes sync first and batches wakeups; lock debug follows boot option; unit prefixes logs with tracepoints.
Softirq snapshots and clears pending, dispatches under time and restart budgets, manages alloc flag and nesting, selects direct or daemon invoke with RCU nesting and empty variants.
Tasklet runs only on running-lock, enabled and scheduled-clear success else requeues.
Pools track running and idle, forbid concurrent same-item run and cursor exec, bound progress by restarts and time, and claim busy identity with clear and release.
Some builds stub timer wake, callback sync and takeover as empty, marking those paths inactive without threading or preemption support.

locks.text: Signal exclusion with interrupts suppressed protects table updates; one alternate-stack build shares that exclusion while the other uses no locking.
Hotplug walks serialize on mutex; bottom-half pairs lockdep with RCU and migration lock; flush saves and restores interrupts around handlers; async checks disable preemption.
Tasklet append and steal hold interrupt protection; normal execution holds per-CPU callback lock across the batch with a waiter protocol yielding briefly for teardown.
Worker needs pool lock with callback lock across pass and nested level for dead drain; work runs without pool lock under read protection with deferred wakeup.

state_machines.text: Pause and suspend sleep until pending, optionally swapping in a temporary mask restored on return, and exit with restart-without-handler status.

Cross-call CPU allocates masks, retains descriptors offline, frees on teardown and drains on dying; hotplug threads loop stop, park, setup, unpark, sleep, run with affinity; lockdep nests softirq in hardirq.
Softirq moves snapshot to clear to dispatch to recheck, looping on budget else delegating to daemon; timer and softirq threads idle until predicates then drain, invoke and reschedule.
Tasklets go scheduled to running to idle with teardown waiting scheduled then running; offline splices tasklet lists to survivors and completes bottom-half pools via ordered queues.

structs.text: Signal views must match size and offsets; sysctl tables expose toggles; cross-call bundles descriptors with masks plus diagnostics; on-CPU holds work, completion, function, data, result and pin.
Hotplug holds CPU, status and registration with idle pointers; softirq holds vectors, daemon, bottom-half lock and count, hardirq state, saved word, NMI nesting, lockdep map and save helpers.
Tasklet queues hold head and tail-link for append and detach; callback sync pairs spin lock with waiter count; thread blocks name task storage, predicates, mains and names.

ABI: alt-stack disabled, on-stack, zero with native and compat minima; mask block, unblock, set with one-shot empty install; wait bit zero, local bit one; hotplug none, active, parked; softirq hi, timer, tx, rx, block, poll, tasklet, sched, hrtimer, rcu.
